title: Sanam Teri Kasam
desc: When Saraswati is thrown out by her father, Inder stands by her through every hardship, bringing them closer. But just as love blooms, destiny intervenes with plans to tear them apart.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.

title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
desc: Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

title: Annapoorani : The Goddess Of Food
desc: Born into an orthodox Hindu family, Annapoorani dreams of becoming a top chef. Battling prejudice and rigid traditions, she must break barriers to pursue her passion and redefine her destiny.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: De De Pyaar De 2
desc: Ashish Mehra, a London-based NRI investor, visits his girlfriend's family, but tensions escalate when her father discovers the truth about Ashish's real age.

title: Khaali Peeli
desc: Childhood sweethearts Pooja and Blackie reunite years later when she escapes a brothel and crosses paths with him, now a taxi driver, leading to an emotional, action-packed journey.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Hello Darling
desc: Candy, Mansi, and Satvari work at a fashion store, but face constant harassment from their creepy manager Hardhik, making their daily lives stressful and full of uncomfortable challenges.

title: Mard
desc: King Azad is imprisoned by the ambitious General Dyer, who seizes his kingdom. Years later, Azad's son rises to challenge Dyer's tyranny and reclaim his rightful legacy.

title: Gopi Kishan
desc: Policeman Gopi's lookalike Kishan, a crook, exploits the resemblance to pursue his goals and find his father, bringing unexpected chaos and benefits into Gopi's life.

title: Honeymoon Travels Pvt. Ltd
desc: Six newly married couples unravel secrets about their respective spouses and also resolve their issues and mend their sorrows.

title: Aa Ab Laut Chalen
desc: Rohan Khanna moves to the US for work and finds himself torn between Pooja and Loveleen. Eventually, he realises his heart belongs to Pooja and returns to her.

title: AB Tumhare Hawale Watan Saathiyo
desc: Kunal reluctantly joins the army to uphold his family's legacy but soon faces ruthless terrorists threatening Indo-Pak peace, pushing him to rise and protect his nation.

title: Kurukshetra
desc: ACP Prithviraj, an honest officer, arrests Chief Minister Baburao's son for rape. In retaliation, Baburao spares no effort to take vengeance against Prithviraj.

title: Vanvaas
desc: An elderly father abandoned by his sons and struggling with fading memory begins a heartfelt journey, guided by a clever wanderer determined to reunite him with his family.
